name: agentworks
description: A VS Code extension for multi-agent engineering work between developer, Codex, and Claude in one chat thread.

agentWorks.codexApiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated in the local CLI bridge approach. The extension uses your existing Codex CLI login.

agentWorks.claudeApiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated in the local CLI bridge approach. The extension uses your existing Claude CLI login.

agentWorks.codexModel.description: Model name used for the Codex-side agent.

agentWorks.codexReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort used for the Codex-side agent. Lower settings usually improve first-token latency and throughput.

agentWorks.codexSandbox.description: Sandbox mode used for the Codex-side agent. workspace-write allows editing files in the workspace and running local tests.

agentWorks.codexCliPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Codex CLI. Useful when VS Code cannot find it from PATH.

agentWorks.claudeModel.description: Model name used for the Claude-side agent.

agentWorks.claudePermissionMode.description: Permission mode used for the Claude-side agent. acceptEdits allows code changes without making Claude completely unrestricted.

agentWorks.claudeTools.description: Tool set exposed to Claude. Use 'default' to allow its standard coding tools.

agentWorks.claudeCliPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Claude CLI. Useful when VS Code cannot find it from PATH.

agentWorks.systemPrompt.default: You are participating in a collaborative engineering chat with a developer and another AI agent. Be concise, concrete, and technically rigorous.
agentWorks.systemPrompt.description: Base system prompt shared with both agents.

agentWorks.enableMockResponses.description: Use local mock responses instead of the installed Codex and Claude CLIs.
